# pve_container_resume (Action)

Resumes a suspended LXC container (`POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/status/resume`). Requires the `VM.PowerMgmt` privilege on `/vms/{vmid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Resumes the suspended container 100 on pve1. Invoke with:
#   apply it from a resource lifecycle block: actions = [action.pve_container_resume.resume_ct100]
action "pve_container_resume" "resume_ct100" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    vmid = 100
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node the container runs on.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the container. Must be between 100 and 999999999.
